name: Temken
description: An elf of the Survivors who finds Gwenna and leads elves to safety.

description_citations.text: "The Colors of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Temken convinces Gwenna to help trap the malevolent shadow in the bayou; Gwenna dies, letting Temken lead the elves to safety.
timeline.quote: Together, Temken and Gwenna fight the shadow being and succeed in trapping it, although Gwenna sacrifices her life in the process.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "A Song out of Darkness , by Loren L. Coleman". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
